0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The worried woman has a fuzzy wuzzy problem.

24.original: Search for signs of the runaway cat.

25.original: Chase down and catch the runaway cat.

26.original: Return the runaway cat to the worried woman.

48.original: Ah, you there! Have you seen a black cat nearby? She's wearing a red collar with a big bell attached.

49.original: We got separated during the upheaval the other day, but I spotted her in the area not too long ago! I tried to tell her there was nothing to be afraid of now, but she didn't seem convinced...

51.original: I'm afraid I haven't seen her...

52.original: Sounds like you could use a hand.

54.original: You haven't? In that case, if it isn't too much to ask, perhaps you'd be so kind as to help me look for her?

55.original: Are you sure!? Oh, that would be wonderful!

56.original: Did you hear that!? Is that you, my precious little fuzzy wuzzy!?

57.original: Oh... Don't toy with me like that! To make up for that cruel joke, I think you should help search for her.

58.original: If I leave it any longer, I fear she'll get a taste for freedom and never come back! I'm sure you'll be able to coax her back, though. Please, your assistance would mean the world to me!

59.original: I sensed something in you the moment we met─I'm all but certain my little fuzzy wuzzy will take a liking to you! So, what do you say? Can I count on you?

60.original: Before you set off, there's something you should know: my little fuzzy wuzzy simply adores being chased. When you find her, be sure to play along and tire her out─she'll settle down soon enough. Anyway, I suggest you head to the plaza and take a look around!

61.original: As I said, she loves being chased. You'll need to tire her out before trying to catch her! Good luck!

62.original: A black cat sporting a fetching red collar eyes you warily. This must be the missing cat you've been asked to track down.

63.original: She seems to have identified you as a worthy playmate. You might be able to catch her if you tire her out.

64.original: Although you get the impression the cat has near-limitless energy reserves, you resolve to give chase.

65.original: Tire the cat out and then get close enough to swoop in and make your catch!

66.original: You can stop giving chase by leaving the area. You may try again by surveying the designated location.

68.original: How did you fare? Did you find her!?

69.original: My little fuzzy wuzzy! Back at last!

70.original: You must have given her quite the chase. She looks about ready for a catnap! Honestly, it's a relief to see her unharmed and healthy.

71.original: I'm from Tural originally, but I was stranded here after the barrier went up. It was this little scamp's grandma that helped me through those dark days after I realized I'd be unable to return home...

72.original: Indeed, I don't know where I'd be without all of my precious little fuzzy wuzzies. Thank you so much for your help!
